title: cappedsoft_failed_change_reliability_support
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Imported historical route; consult the named source for the original hypothesis.

result.summary: On 64 exact disagreement states, 51.6% of seed4363 changes were negative and only 32.8% were nonnegative against all three opponents; worst-opponent mean was -0.832 +/-0.613 bb/state. Three residual seeds were unanimous on 87.5% of rows and on 27/33 negative rows. Exact 2048-state training support yielded nearest/action-legal AUC 0.649/0.681, with six missing action-legal support rows all negative and extreme BB/SB-flop novelty.
result.conclusion: Do not use candidate-continuation conversion, optimizer-seed disagreement, sampling uncertainty alone, or a deployed distance/kNN gate as the primary repair.
result.next_step: Aggregate all-legal counterfactual data on candidate-disagreement and missing legal-context support, then learn source preservation and action ranking into weights with cross-seed/cross-opponent/tail gates.
